comment: Each mutation injects one gross error; tests/e2e/run.py --mutations shows every applicable one turns the suite red. Model mutations edit the imported model (pipeline.cjs MUTATIONS); source mutations re-evaluate an app module with a known fix reverted (SOURCE_MUTATIONS). Edit-flow mutations damage the saved KiCad board after the save (edit-flow.cjs MUTATIONS); tests/e2e/edit-flow.py --mutations shows each turns the edit flow red.
